comments.author: @michaeltakayama8415
comments.text: Yep, definitely a theme park, complete with higher prices, tons of tourists & long lines - but, looks like a nice one!  :)

comments.author: @jamrellb
comments.text:
Yep! I'd recommend seeing it at least once because that cable car ride was jaw-dropping. The sea of clouds was also something I'll never forget. If it weren't for the long lines and crazy crowd, this place would be one of my favorites. 

Do you have a favorite theme park, Michael?

comments.author: @michaeltakayama8415
comments.text:
@jamrellb  My favorite theme park is the original Disneyland in California, followed by the (much) larger Walt Disney World in Florida.

I actually had the opportunity to work for Disney on several projects at both parks, which made the experience even better.  :)

comments.author: @jamrellb
comments.text: @michaeltakayama8415  Wow that sounds amazing! I've never been there so that's definitely in my bucket list now :)
